summary: A hung Google or mailer call inside a tick job ran past the route's maxDuration: the heartbeat was not written and the jobs after it never ran while the provider was slow.
fix: Every Google and mailer call in a tick stops at the start budget + 1 s; jobs the budget skipped run first on the next tick.

summary: The Gmail mailer's send had no timeout, so a hung socket held the request until the function was killed.
fix: A 10 s timeout on every Gmail send, shortened by the tick's hard stop.

summary: /api/health reported the tick ok while every job threw on every tick.
fix: The heartbeat records the failed count; a tick where every job failed fails the tick check, a partial failure is a warning.

summary: The public /api/health body named each check's internal state.
fix: The public body says only ok/fail per check; reason codes and warnings need the cron secret.

summary: A guest joining or leaving a host's locked booking never reached Google: the host-event patch sent time and text only, so a joined guest got no invite and a removed one kept theirs. The mock calendar did not model attendees, so tests could not see it.
fix: Patch rows written for a joined-guest change carry {attendees: true}; the gateway then GETs the event and sends the new attendee list, keeping every staying attendee's entry (and responseStatus). The mock now keeps attendees the way Google does.

summary: One 401 on a cached access token recorded last_error 'unauthorized' and sent Jon the reconnect email, even when a fresh refresh would have worked.
fix: On a 401 the gateway drops the cached token, refreshes and retries once; only a second 401 or a failed refresh reaches the alert.

title: Manage link ran out while a re-requested booking was still open
symptom: After Ask for another time on a locked booking (or its host leaving, for joined guests), every live manage link kept the old end + 7 days, so the guest saw Link expired while still waiting on Jon.
fix: A locked booking that goes back to waiting on Jon gives its live manage links at least the unlocked lifetime (120 days from now); joined guests get the same when their host leaves.

title: Proposing new times locked the request before its host
symptom: A weather-called joined guest proposing new times while Jon promoted a sibling to host could end in a deadlock (40P01) and a 500 on one side.
fix: proposeTimes locks the host row first (lockHostOf), then the request, as every other joined-guest action does.

title: CSV invite import could write part of the file
symptom: Each row was its own transaction, so a failure at row N left N-1 invites; a re-upload then made duplicates.
fix: All rows are written in one transaction (createInvite takes the caller's client).

title: story.invite_id foreign key had no index
symptom: Removing an invite (on delete set null) and purging stories by invite scanned the story table.
fix: Migration 20261102000740_story_invite_index.sql adds story_invite_id_idx.

title: A refused upload could be finalised again
symptom: A refused upload (too big or unreadable) could be re-sent to the same path and finalised again, re-running the image decode each time; only successful finalises were counted.
fix: A refused upload is marked done without a photo (finalised_at set, photo_id null); finalising it again answers not_found before any download.

title: No daily cap on guest intake emails from the general invite
symptom: The general link sends E1/E6 to whatever address is typed, bounded only by the per-IP limit, so the daily email budget could be spent on it.
fix: Per general invite, at most 20 guest intake emails a day (requestSendInvite); over it the request is still stored and Jon still gets E2.

title: Other people's attempts could refuse the admin's correct sign-in code
symptom: The per-address verify bucket counted every attempt, so 10 tries at the admin's address from anywhere refused the admin's correct code for an hour.
fix: The per-address bucket counts only wrong codes, after the check; the per-IP limit still counts every attempt.

title: Scrubber missed names and free-text keys, and pg failing-row details
symptom: Keys like contact_name, pitch_idea or before60_answer in Sentry extras/tags passed through, and a check violation's 'Failing row contains (...)' kept the row values.
fix: SENSITIVE also matches name, pitch, need_to_know, answer, plan and detail; scrubText redacts 'Failing row contains (...)'.

title: Siteverify hostname was not checked
symptom: A solve from any site using our key passed.
fix: Outside prototype, siteverify's hostname must equal NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL's host (a mismatch is reported).

title: A chunked beacon body was read whole before the size check
symptom: Without a Content-Length, POST /api/events buffered the entire body before refusing it as over 256 bytes.
fix: The body is read with a bounded reader that stops once it passes the limit.

title: Free/busy refetch had no single flight
symptom: After the 10-minute cache expired, every guest render called Google until one write landed.
fix: The refetch runs under a transaction advisory lock; renders that arrive meanwhile serve the stale cache.

title: A Surprise plan was stored on any dish
symptom: surprisePlan sent with a non-Surprise dish was stored as surprise_plan_sealed, and Jon saw 'Sealed plan on file' on that request.
fix: storableBody drops surprisePlan unless the dish is Surprise Me.

summary: A bounce or complaint webhook for an email whose provider id wasn't stored yet was acknowledged and recorded, so it was never redelivered and the bounce was lost.
fix: Such an event is answered 503 with nothing stored, so it is delivered again later.

summary: Rows sent by the Gmail mailer were polled at Resend for 72 h, using up the per-tick call budget.
fix: The poll claim skips gmail: ids.

summary: Nothing pruned webhook_event.
fix: The pruning job (now prune-old-rows) drops rows older than 7 days.

summary: Concurrent E1 sends to one address could all pass the 3-a-day cap (count then insert).
fix: A per-address transaction lock before the count.

summary: A joined guest's story was dated by the day it came in, not the date of the time together.
fix: The date falls back to the host's slot, then the locked start.

summary: dev_outbox kept every rendered prototype email, live links included, forever.
fix: A prototype-only tick job drops rows older than 7 days.

summary: The tick route compared the cron secret with its own code instead of the shared helper.
fix: Every cron and job route uses hasCronSecret.

summary: The no-dev-routes check named four routes and probed only /dev/outbox, so /dev/axe was not proven absent.
fix: The check lists every route under src/app/dev and probes each one.

summary: /dev POSTs authenticated by cookie had no Origin check (AD-7).
fix: devGuard refuses a cookie-authenticated non-GET from another origin.

summary: Once only wrong codes counted per address, the count never stopped the next try, so codes for one address could be tried without end from many IPs.
fix: Before checking a typed code, the per-address count of wrong codes this hour is read; at 30 no typed code is checked for that address until the hour ends. The emailed link still signs in.

summary: Locks and stand-by offers took only the week of a range's start, so a range running from Sunday into Monday was not serialised with a lock or stand-by offer in the second week; two live stand-by offers could hold overlapping cross-week windows.
fix: lockWeeksOf locks every week the range touches, in date order (lock.ts, standby.ts).

summary: The block-confirm move re-implemented the block rule in SQL, and Suggest another time checked neither blocks nor the season, so a blocked or out-of-season time could be offered and the guest's take then failed.
fix: One engine rule, blockedBy (rules.ts), used by canLock, the block-confirm check and Suggest; Suggest refuses a blocked (in_block) or out-of-season time.

summary: A second /story visit within the 2-hour twj_story capability edited the first story instead of starting a new one, so the earlier story was lost.
fix: Only a save marked edit (a later save in the same page view) updates the capability's story; any other save creates one.

summary: A first story-page save retried after a lost answer (no twj_story yet) created a second story and spent a second place in the daily limit.
fix: The page view's clientKey makes the first save idempotent on story(source, idempotency_key); a retry gets the same story and its twj_story back.

summary: An edit whose story had been deleted fell through to an insert with no bot check, no daily limit and no new capability.
fix: An edit never creates: saveStoryPageStory only updates, and the route answers the stale line (403 capability_expired).

summary: A Weather call, or a block/away change that sent a locked booking back to needing a new time, left its manage links (and its joined guests') expiring at the old end + 7 days while the request was still open.
fix: Both paths reopen the live manage links of the request and its joined guests for the unlocked lifetime (reopenManageTokens, the same rule as Ask for another time).

summary: Finalising an upload for a story that already had its photos downloaded and decoded the image before refusing it, and kept the raw upload (which may carry GPS).
fix: A full story is refused before the raw file is read; the upload is marked refused and its raw file deleted, also when the story fills up during the finalise.

summary: A stand-by request's detail was treated as closed: no Lock in, no Suggest another time, and the Before 60 box (meant for after the time together) showed, although the engine allows locking a stand-by request.
fix: The detail view treats stand-by like an open request for its actions and keeps the Stand-by tab; Move to stand-by is not offered again.

summary: The weather-call /new-date grid offered every season day, including Thu Apr 1 (the household hold) and blocked days, so Send was refused with 'One of those times just went'; /book already greyed them.
fix: /new-date greys the engine's off dates for the request's dish and invite, the same call as /book (rule 11, with the hold).

summary: After Cancel for the guest or a Weather call in the same page view, the request detail still showed 'Locked in. Invite sent.' above the new state.
fix: The lock's line is kept only while the page reads the request as locked; once it reads otherwise it goes.

summary: On /sent and /story the photo tile's 'Added' and 'Remove' were dark text drawn straight on the photo, unreadable on a dark photo.
fix: The tile's words sit on a solid paper chip with ink text (.photo-chip), whatever the photo.
